title: A held cloud run's own 'run the epic again' only re-attaches: resume must supersede the waiting Workflow
description: Incident 2026-10-07, epic ilz: the cloud run halted on land_review_not_ready and told the operator to fix the doc and 'run the epic again with ticfac run ilz --cloud'. After the fix was pushed to epic/ilz, that command found the Workflow still running (parked on work:signal waiting for an answer) and merely attached, replaying the old halt; nothing re-reviewed. The only way forward was ticfac cloud stop --now, waiting out the work:grace step (5m), then a new submission. Fix: when a run is held for a person and the operator re-runs the epic (and the epic branch moved since the hold, or always), the submit supersedes the parked Workflow — signal it to end cleanly and start the resume submission — instead of attaching; or the halt message names the command that actually works. Test: a held cloud run + rerun produces a new submission that re-reads the review.
acceptance_criteria: ticfac run <epic> --cloud on a held cloud run resumes it (new submission) without a manual stop; test covers it; make gate passes
closed_reason: fixed by PR #256 (91fc04c): rerun supersedes a held cloud run; resume re-reviews a changed tree; nothing-to-dispatch is a named stop
